mapper.insert: INSERT INTO budgets (user_id, category_id, limit_amount, month) VALUES (#{userId}, #{categoryId}, #{limitAmount}, #{month})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM budgets WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT b.*, c.name as categoryName FROM budgets b LEFT JOIN categories c ON b.category_id = c.id WHERE b.user_id = #{userId} AND b.month = #{month}
SELECT b.*, c.name as categoryName FROM budgets b LEFT JOIN categories c ON b.category_id = c.id WHERE b.user_id = #{userId}

SELECT b.id, b.limit_amount as budgetLimit, b.month, c.name as categoryName, COALESCE(SUM(ABS(t.amount)), 0) as spent FROM budgets b LEFT JOIN categories c ON b.category_id = c.id LEFT JOIN transactions t ON t.category_id = b.category_id AND t.user_id = b.user_id AND DATE_FORMAT(t.date, '%Y-%m') = b.month AND t.type = 'EXPENSE' WHERE b.user_id = #{userId} AND b.month = #{month} GROUP BY b.id, b.limit_amount, b.month, c.name
